method.request: GET with response close after at most 16384 HTML bytes; no binary downloads

limitations: HTTP accessibility is not factual verification, endorsement, or confirmation of full-text access.
403, 429, timeouts, TLS and network errors are separate categories and do not establish that a link is invalid.
An HTTP 404 is called confirmed only if both requests returned 404; links are never deleted or changed by this script.
Fenced/indented code, inline code, placeholder/example/local URLs and credential-bearing URLs are excluded. HTML fragment identifiers are removed for request deduplication.
Only up to 16 KiB of an HTML response is read for a title; no experimental procedure/full-text content is extracted or retained. Binary bodies are not downloaded.
The timeout is a socket-operation timeout; a redirect chain can take longer than 15 seconds. Some 2xx responses may still be soft errors or access challenges undetectable from the HTML title.

An initial non-checkpointed run was stopped after reporting 125 aggregate completions to fix two Markdown extraction errors and narrow retries. Its per-URL results were not retained, and its requests are not included in recorded_http_attempts.
cached_retrieved records reuse the explicitly named preceding source-access audit; they are not presented as fresh HTTP 200 responses.
